cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e9d.title: HR Generalist – Fulfillment Centers
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:e9d.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our four online stores—Backcountry, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport and, SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Sr. HR Manager Location: Christiansburg, VA, On-Site 100%, No Remote Options About the Role You will serve as the on-site HR presence for Backcountry's Virginia Fulfillment Center, owning the full people function for a high-volume hourly workforce where your decisions directly shape culture, retention, and operational performance. Your scope spans every touchpoint of the employee lifecycle, and your impact is felt on the floor every day. At 6-12 months, success looks like measurable improvement in turnover, a supervisory team that is meaningfully stronger in their people management capability, and ER matters handled with consistency, speed, and zero compliance exposure. Leaders trust you, employees know you, and HR is seen as a driver of results and not a back-office function. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0659be1d-11c5-.title: Engineering Manager - Product
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0659be1d-11c5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Product based in South Africa. This is an opportunity to lead a high-impact product engineering team within an early-stage, fully distributed software environment. You’ll guide a compact group of engineers responsible for turning customer needs into valuable, reliable product capabilities. The team works across cloud spend management, data pipelines, visualization, and intuitive product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with customer needs and business goals. The role combines people leadership, delivery ownership, technical judgment, and organizational development. You’ll have meaningful influence over engineering standards, team growth, hiring, and how products move from idea to launch. It’s an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who thrives on autonomy, collaboration, and building high-performing teams in a fast-moving environment. Lead, coach, develop, and grow a compact product engineering team while maintaining a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture. Establish clear priorities, maintain alignment across the team, remove delivery blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward product goals. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer needs and business priorities into focused engineering initiatives. Guide the team in balancing delivery speed, technical quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making engineering tradeoffs. Enable engineers to take ownership of features from initial concepts and technical planning through implementation, testing, and launch. Establish and maintain practical standards for software design, testing, documentation, technical decisions, and engineering processes. Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of new engineering talent as the organization grows. Strengthen collaboration across engineering, product, design, and leadership to ensure decisions are clear and execution remains coordinated. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and strong communication. Help the team deliver dependable and performant product capabilities across spend management, data, visualization, and application infrastructure. Requirements Proven experience managing and developing software engineering teams, ideally within a product-focused technology environment. Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams, develop engineers, and create an environment where people can do their best work. Strong product mindset with the ability to understand customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations when setting engineering direction. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain clarity across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Strong judgment when balancing velocity, engineering quality, technical debt, and customer impact. Experience enabling engineers to own features and projects throughout the complete development lifecycle. Comfortable operating in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment where processes and priorities continue to develop. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Design, and senior leadership. Experience with or familiarity with modern software development environments such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Terraform, GCP, dbt, and Dagster is beneficial but not mandatory. Experience leading engineers within a young startup is a strong plus. Exposure to FinOps, cloud infrastructure, cloud cost optimization, or data platforms is advantageous. Hands-on experience with a comparable modern technology stack is also a plus. Benefits Base salary of up to $300,000 CAD , plus additional compensat

jobgether-jobgether:lever:95effdd1-a7ff-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will manage a diverse regional event calendar spanning customer events, partner-led workshops, roadshows, trade shows, and webinars. The role combines strategic program management with hands-on execution, from logistics and partner coordination to copywriting, email campaigns, and post-event follow-up. You will work closely with regional sales teams, strategic partners, prospective customers, and internal marketing stakeholders. Your ability to adapt global messaging to local B2B audiences will be key to driving engagement and registrations. Plan, coordinate, and execute a comprehensive calendar of regional marketing programs across Western Europe, including customer events, partner roadshows, workshops, trade shows, and virtual webinars. Monitor campaign and event performance, analyze relevant marketing metrics, and use insights to continuously improve regional programs. Proven experience managing both virtual events and webinars using platforms such as Zoom or ON24, as well as in-person events, trade shows, or customer programs. Strong understanding of marketing metrics, reporting, lead tracking, and using data to evaluate and improve campaign performance. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f6c39256-be65-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Craftsperson/Automation based in Switzerland. Join a remote-first engineering environment where software quality and craftsmanship are treated as core engineering disciplines. You’ll own testing across the full software development lifecycle, working alongside developers in a continuous deployment model. The role combines functional testing, automation, programming, infrastructure, and close collaboration with product teams and clients. You’ll build and evolve automation frameworks while using AI responsibly to make testing faster, smarter, and more effective. Your work will directly influence product stability, user experience, and the predictability of production releases. msgsports-msgsports:greenhouse:518581400.description: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSG Sports) is a leading professional sports company, with a collection of assets that includes the New York Knicks (NBA) and the New York Rangers (NHL), as well as two development league teams – the Westchester Knicks (NBAGL) and the Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). MSG Sports also operates a professional sports team performance center – the MSG Training Center in Greenburgh, NY. More information is available at www.msgsports.com. Who are we hiring? The Manager Finance is responsible for FP&A functions supporting Venue Operations & Food Beverage & Merchandise functions at the Theaters (Radio City Music Hall, Beacon & Chicago Theaters). This includes preparation of the annual budget, monthly forecasts as well as month end reporting & analysis. This role will work closely and support the operations teams for each respective area to ensure all material variances are known and reported on monthly management reporting packages. What will you do? Preparation of annual operating & capital budgets, monthly forecasts & business reviews for Venue Operations, & Food Beverage & Merchandise across all events at the theaters (Radio City, Beacon, Chicago) Prepare & present month-end reporting packages with variance analysis to department heads & General Manager. Prepare & distribute various Food, Beverage & Merchandise reports, including post-event flash reports, weekly revenue actual vs budget, ad hoc product, quantity, sales, ROI analyses. Maintain and analyze monthly tracking files for key expenses including labor, utilities, taxes, licenses and permits, and capital expenditures. Collaborate with and support the Accounting team during month end close by reviewing P&L’s, researching variances, and communicating findings. Analyze Data Warehouse information on Food & Merchandise to ensure accurate data flows from POS systems. Support and assist integration of new POS systems. Manage day-to-day financial operations, including union and part-time labor tracking vs. plan, ensuring staffing levels remain within budget. Support various business units by performing ad hoc analyses, approving purchase orders, providing account coding, and responding to miscellaneous financial questions and requests. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field, MBA a plus. 5 years’ experience in Finance/Accounting/Strategy, preferably in financial analysis and budgeting in the Entertainment or Sports industry. Strong analytical skills. Prior knowledge of facilities finance a plus, which includes Union/Part time labor, rent & property tax, utilities, repairs & maintenance. Strong skills in systems currently utilized, i.e. Excel, Tableau, Oracle GL, Oracle planning (Hyperion), as well as various food beverage & Ability to work both independently to trouble shoot and problem solve. Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and open to learning new ways of working. Ability to be a reliable team member, capable of effective collaboration to achieve our shared goals across teams, departments, and companies. Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, tailoring the message based on the purpose, audience, and channel. #LI-Onsite Pay Range $83,000 — $130,000 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds!
